editorial:
Imagine walking into a therapy session expecting a friendly chat, only to find yourself facing a psychologist who refuses to play by the rules. You will follow Alexander, a shy guy who keeps everything locked inside, as he gets pushed to his absolute limit. The vibe is tense and feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, but instead of a chase, it is all about secrets and old wounds. You can tell right away that this is not your typical doctor-patient relationship because the doctor is more interested in breaking Alexander down than just comforting him.

The acting is the real star here, as you can feel the stress building up in every scene. While the slow start might bore some people, the way the tension peaks makes it worth the wait. If you enjoy movies that focus on human psychology and shocking reveals, you will love this. To get the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch every facial expression. If you prefer owning your films, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the high quality.
endingExplained: The final scenes reveal that the psychologist was not trying to cure Alexander, but was actually using him for a social experiment. The big twist is that the therapist manipulated Alexander's memories to trigger a breakdown on purpose. In the end, Alexander realizes he was just a pawn in a game. He finally finds his voice and stands up for himself, leaving the session and the therapist behind to start his life over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character studies and plot twists.
